name: framefields-styles
description: Choose and combine the creative direction of a framefields video — its look (Motion, Collage, Blueprint, Keynote …), format (widescreen, vertical 9:16, square, 15/30 s ad), genre (explainer, product launch, brand film, lyric video) and media (code-drawn, 3D, footage, AI-generated through the framefields gateway) — or start from a preset. Use when someone asks for a video "in the style of" something, names a platform or length, asks what kind of video to make, wants AI-generated clips to match dr
